screeningSummary: Elderly widow's engagement ring vanished during a 1979 missing-time episode - it reappeared on her nightstand last week, worn and cracked
arcNotes: Crazy-but-sincere. Vern treats her with dignity, shares returned-object lore, gives real preservation protocol (bag, date, jeweler photos). Ends warm

lines.text: It's my engagement ring. My husband gave it to me in 1962. In August of '79 I lost it - I lost four hours that night too, and the ring was gone off my finger. Last Tuesday I woke up and it was sitting on my nightstand. Same ring. Except the inscription inside is worn smooth now, and there's a crack in the stone that wasn't there before.
